title: most european cups.
question: Which club has won the most European Cups?

items.name: Barcelona
items.fact: Five titles between 1992 and 2015, plus three lost finals.

items.name: Liverpool
items.fact: Six titles, and four more finals that ended in defeat.

items.name: Bayern Munich
items.fact: Won three in a row: 1974, 1975 and 1976.

items.name: AC Milan
items.fact: Seven titles, the first in 1963 and the last in 2007.

items.name: Real Madrid
items.fact: Won the first five European Cups in a row, 1956 to 1960.

ending: Holders Paris Saint-Germain have only two titles, but they won both of the last two finals.
